quests.title: A Receiving Place
quests.text: Personal effects from the front are waiting in the mourners' hall's receiving court here in Nhal Veyr. Sort the prepared bundles for their return, keeping each person's things together. Whoever comes to collect them should not have to search through another family's grief.
quests.lesson: A free front task of the giver's own people (a level only).
quests.notes: Round 62 FRONTQUESTS. Draft OS1: the town place of Nhal Veyr's mourners' hall (chapter 1's, another object).

quests.title: Dressed for the Long Rest
quests.text: Our shroud cupboard is nearly bare, and I refuse to enter 'wrapped in a sack' beside another name. Bring me two Glass Silk from the Gossamer Widows at night in the {name:front_skyglass_canopy/rootways}, which lie {zone_area:front_skyglass_canopy/rootways}. We may keep our dead for centuries; we can at least dress them properly.
quests.notes: Round 62 FRONTQUESTS. Draft OS2 (K8 A): Glass Silk from the Gossamer Widows (night, the Skyglass rootways); its id and objective stay, it opens at 54; Nhal Veyr's weapon (a solo quest).

quests.title: Not Entered as Salvage
quests.text: The recovery crews have brought personal effects to the {name:front_gravesalt_escarpment/recovery_post}, where they risk being counted among the ordinary salvage. Record the names on those belongings before the loads are combined. I need an account that will still make sense when someone asks after a person instead of a weight of metal.

objectives.label: Record the names on the effects

quests.lesson: A free front task of the giver's own people (a level only).
quests.notes: Round 62 FRONTQUESTS. Draft OS3: a use at the new recipe place P6 (Gravesalt's tombwood, away from Huskell).

quests.title: Optional: No New Volume
quests.text: Someone has pressed a branded coin into the survey cairn at {name:r20_anchor_075} on The Wyrmglass Crown, entering an island in the books as though it were another debtor. Get a boat from the Shipwright, cross to the island and pry the brand-coin from the capstone. I have spent centuries correcting the registers of the dead; I refuse to open a new volume for mountains.

objectives.label: Pry the brand-coin from the survey cairn

quests.notes: Round 62 FRONTQUESTS. Draft OS4: the optional island use, free from 60 without a story prerequisite.
